title: Batched High-Order mTHP Swap-in for Zswap
subtitle: agy (gemini4argon) · line: exp4-mthp-zswapin-batch · base 5e84ca92 · 1 candidate · 20 guests / 0 builds

verdict.headline: Screening benchmark: assembling contiguous compressed zswap slots into high-order folios yields -4.7% sequential and -5.8% p99 latency reduction on zswap, but geomean effect (-2.3%) remains within the calibrated noise floor.

sections.title: Eliminating repeated order-0 page faults in zswap mTHP swapin
sections.lead: Linux disables mTHP swap-in when zswap is enabled, forcing 16 or 64 independent order-0 faults with repeated page table allocations and PTL acquisitions.

blocks.text: Hypothesis 4 enables high-order folios (orders 2 and 4) when contiguous slots reside in zswap, assembling compressed slots into one folio under a single set_ptes hold.

sections.title: Where the fault overhead appears
sections.lead: Under standard order-0 swapin, each subpage triggers a distinct fault, PTE lookup, and spinlock acquisition. Batched swap-in amortizes these costs under a single lock hold.

blocks.takeaway: Batched swapin amortizes PTL acquisitions and folio allocations across multiple compressed slots

sections.title: The affected path: thp_swapin_suitable_orders and zswap_load
sections.lead: In mm/memory.c, thp_swapin_suitable_orders permits orders <= 4 when zswap_all_present() is true; in mm/zswap.c, zswap_load decompresses each slot directly into folio subpages.

blocks.takeaway: Multi-subpage decompression addresses subpages directly within high-order folio

sections.title: Kernel modifications in mm/memory.c and mm/zswap.c
sections.lead: Updated zswap_decompress to accept subpage offset via folio_page, implemented zswap_all_present with tree read locking, and mapped high-order folios via swapin_sync.

blocks.takeaway: Direct subpage decompression into high-order folio

blocks.x_label: Metadata bytes per 1,000 capacity slots (baseline only)
blocks.note: Valid calibration samples; candidate performance was not measured here.

sections.title: Architectural decision: exploratory screening completed
sections.lead: Candidate passed all 17 correctness gates, probe calibration, and fast screening. Latency dropped -4.7% sequential on zram-64k, but geomean (-2.3%) stayed within noise.

blocks.text: Batched high-order swapin confirms viability for zswap folios, but without asynchronous prefetch (Exp 3), decompression latency stays on the critical fault path.
